content.comment_body: I am looking to keep the backlight of the [product_name] display always on. Are there any potential issues, such as damage to the display, reduced LED lifespan, or overheating?
According to the manual, there is only guidance for the [product_name] display. I believe the same information applies to the [product_name] display you mentioned.

In several installations, I have kept the [product_name] backlight continuously set to white, switching to amber for attention and red for alarms. After two years, there are no signs of wear. The screen stays cool. From my experience, the function keys are more likely to fail before the backlight does.
I agree; in our setup, the backlight has run 24/7 for over two years with no problems.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are reviewing the effects of maintaining the backlight on a [product_name] display permanently. Their discussion focuses on possible hardware concerns, including display wear, decreased LED life, and increased heat. Users with long-term use report no significant issues with the backlight always on.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the product to remain dependable and safe with the backlight continuously enabled, not leading to early hardware failure or overheating.
